purpose: Post hoc, after v7s's record and v7t's: v7s's analysis run again with one change, every Firefox capture's page read at the handler's time (performance.now(), page.ndjson's h_ms) instead of the event's time (event.timeStamp, t_ms). It answers whether the time the page logger reads, by itself, changes the judgments of the detectors and the outcome of v7s's criterion on Firefox.
fixed_before_running: Written on 2026-11-20 after v7s's record (9ff1d37a...) and v7t's (a0649ae6..., read on the Mac: Firefox's event times gather near multiples of about 15.6 ms and run 9 to 12 ms behind the handler's; the handler's times and the hook's follow the plan; F_M2's page gaps are 94 to 99% zero at the event's time, 24 to 62% at the handler's; v7t's fixed reading of the event's time was 'not decided') and after the researcher's decision 3 of .steering/20261120-v9-returns. No detector has scored a page at the handler's time. Code: works/prototype_v7u.py, committed with this file; it imports v7s's code at 5508490 and v7t's page reader at 502f31e unchanged and checks them byte for byte, and checks v7s's record by its SHA-256 before reading anything. Amended before any value after the code review (Claude and Codex, 2026-11-20): both variants are loaded and checked (every check v7s makes on the recordings) before anything is scored, so that a stop in variant h comes in seconds; the margins are computed once from variant t's series after a check that both variants' unperturbed sides and margins_of are the same; v7s's runlogs and runs.json are checked against v7s's record before anything is read; variant t is compared with v7s's record also on the human cells and the path_sd tables; the cells outside Firefox's page include the human cells; tests run v7s's own known_tables, compare persons_and_scorer with v7s's main statement for statement, and fix the order of the steps.
method: v7s's main, from KUPA and the persons to the criterion, with one scorer and one set of margins and two variants of the recordings. Both variants are loaded and checked first; the run stops unless their unperturbed sides (plans or H0) and margins_of are the same, and the margins are then computed once from variant t (they read nothing else). Variant t: v7s's loading unchanged. Variant h: v7s's load_item wrapped so that every Firefox item (F_K, F_K_nohook, F_M0, F_M2_8B, F_M2_14B, F_H1) has its page layer at the handler's time: the h_ms of the presses v7's read_page counts (v7t's page_times, which stops unless the presses are read_page's), from the first counted press, with the kinds and counts unchanged. Everything that follows is v7s's code in both variants: the known gaps' path_sd (Firefox's page table therefore from h_ms in variant h), cleaning, scores, predictions (theta 1, 0.5, 2), cells and verdicts. Chrome's captures, v7's captures and every hook layer are read the same way in both variants.
count: valid (as v7s); agreement of variant t with v7s's record (theta 1: machine and human cells whose observed or predicted b, c, n differ, and path_sd table entries that differ); Firefox's page path_sd per known gap in each variant; the verdict over Firefox's tested cells (F_M0, F_M2_8B, F_M2_14B; both layers; valid detectors) and v7s's verdicts over all tested cells, in each variant and theta; Firefox's tested cells (observed and predicted readings, b, c, n, left out, extrapolated) in each variant at theta 1; F_H1's observed and predicted b, c, n (no reading, as v7s); per Firefox series' page and detector the sessions judged in both variants and those judged differently; the number of cells (machine and human, theta 1) outside the page of F_M0, F_M2_8B, F_M2_14B and F_H1 whose observed b, c, n differ between the variants (0 expected: they read the same recordings).

reading.firefox_verdict_h: The main reading: v7s's verdict rule (criterion.verdict, unchanged) over Firefox's tested cells of valid detectors at theta 1 in variant h: 'held', 'failed' or 'not decided' as the rule gives. Thetas 0.5 and 2 are given, not read.
reading.time_choice: Over Firefox's tested page cells of valid detectors at theta 1: 'changes' if at least one cell's observed readings are decided ('not changed' or 'responds') in both variants and differ; 'does not change' if every such cell is decided in both variants and they agree; else 'not decided'.
reading.reproduction: If variant t does not give v7s's record cell for cell, the readings are still those of this run (both variants share its scorer), and the cells not as v7s are written; v7s's own record is not replaced.

limits: Post hoc: v7s's verdict, cells and predictions stay as deposited and read; this run asks what one choice of the page logger does. The handler's time is performance.now() at the keydown handler on a 1 ms grid in this Firefox: it is not the time the key was pressed, and a page logger in the field may read either time. One PC, one Firefox version. F_H1 is 10 persons: flips only, as v7s.
record: results/prototype_v7u/record.json: the counts above and provenance (HEAD, dirty, conditions and code SHA-256, v7s's record SHA-256). Refuses to overwrite.
